metadata.question: On January 23, 2025 at 1:44 pm, did the smoke plume from the Baja California fire (El Escondido area of Ensenada) extend less than 50 km westward over the Pacific Ocean?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need a satellite with both 2025-01-23 acquisitions and a short-wave infrared / visible band able to reveal smoke plumes over ocean. - Sentinel-2 MSI (10-m) passes ≈10:30 local; 1:44 pm ≈ 18:44 UTC, so the 18:44 UTC S-2 overpass is perfect. - Location: El Escondido, Baja California ≈ 31.9°N, 116.8°W. - Collection: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED, filter date 2025-01-23 and geometry around Ensenada. 2. Masking: Smoke question → we do NOT want clouds masking out the plume. Use only the QA60 cloud mask to remove thick clouds; keep thin/low clouds & aerosol so smoke is preserved. A simple smoke-sensitive index is (SWIR1 − VIS) or just SWIR1 (B11) minus green; here I’ll threshold SWIR1 < 0.04 (dark smoke/ocean) and use B4>0.15 to exclude ocean water, leaving only smoke over water or low-reflectance plume. 3. Logic: - If no S-2 image exists → C1. - After masking, count valid “smoke” pixels westward of the ignition point within a 50-km-radius sector. - If count == 0 → C2. - Measure the western-most longitude of any smoke pixel; if that lon > (ignition_lon – 0.5°) ≈ 50 km → A; else B. - Any None/NaN result → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time pt = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.8, 31.9) # El Escondido date = '2025-01-23' west50km = -116.8 - 0.5 # ~50 km west in lon # 2. Acquire Sentinel-2 col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(pt) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day'))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No S2 image on 2025-01-23.") print("C1") img = col.first() # 3. Smoke mask (keep dark SWIR over ocean, exclude thick clouds) smoke = img.select('B11').lt(0.04).And(img.select('B4').gt(0.15)) # 4. Western sector (50 km buffer westward over ocean) sector = pt.buffer(50000).bounds() westSmoke = smoke.updateMask(smoke).clip(sector) # 5. Stats count = westSmoke.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=sector, scale=300, maxPixels=1e9).get('B11').getInfo() if count is None or count == 0: print("No smoke pixels west of fire.") print("C2") maxWest = (westSmoke.selfMask() .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.min(), scale=300, maxPixels=1e9, crs='EPSG:4322', geometry=sector) .get('B11').getInfo()) if maxWest is None: print("C3") print(f"Smoke pixels: {int(count)}") # if western-most smoke lon > west50km threshold → plume <50 km west if maxWest > west50km: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.8, 31.9)            # El Escondido
date = '2025-01-23'
west50km = -116.8 - 0.5                         # ~50 km west in lon

# 2. Acquire Sentinel-2
col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
         .filterBounds(pt)
         .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')))
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No S2 image on 2025-01-23.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

img = col.first()
# 3. Smoke mask (keep dark SWIR over ocean, exclude thick clouds)
smoke = img.select('B11').lt(0.04).And(img.select('B4').gt(0.15))
# 4. Western sector (50 km buffer westward over ocean)
sector = pt.buffer(50000).bounds()
westSmoke = smoke.updateMask(smoke).clip(sector)

# 5. Stats
count = westSmoke.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                               geometry=sector, scale=300, maxPixels=1e9).get('B11').getInfo()
if count is None or count == 0:
    print("No smoke pixels west of fire.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

maxWest = (westSmoke.selfMask()
           .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.min(), scale=300, maxPixels=1e9,
                         crs='EPSG:4322', geometry=sector)
           .get('B11').getInfo())
if maxWest is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"Smoke pixels: {int(count)}")
# if western-most smoke lon > west50km threshold → plume <50 km west
if maxWest > west50km:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
